reviews.review:
This is a great RC game, best I've tried by far. 

Been doing offroad-rc off and on for near 20 years. Racing, backyard tracks, bashing you name it. This is the first time I've had the same feeling in a game. The racing feels great once you get a feel for it and you can practice things like whips without damaging your car. Runs great on the steam deck too and is a great game to chill and run some laps of you favorite track. 

As long as this stays in development I'm excited for its future. For now its great for running laps, playing community tracks, and building your own track or replicating a local one. Would love car tuning (Camber, caster, toe, esc settings, diff, suspension preload, compression/rebound) and servo/motor choices. Just to add more variety to the cars since the choices are limited right now. 

Looking forward to more, I hope we get more content even if what we have is replayable as hell.
